content:
Just weeks after announcing the Apple Music price hike, Apple announced today (16th) that the Apple TV+ monthly subscription fee will also increase. Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that the Apple TV+ monthly fee will be raised from US$12.99 (about HK$117) to US$14.99 (about HK$117).

The Apple One Individual plan monthly fee will also rise in tandem.

Apple TV+ and Apple One price increases

The details of the price increase are as follows:

  • Apple TV+ (monthly): US$14.99 (original price US$12.99)
  • Apple TV+ (annual): US$119 (original price US$99)
  • Apple One Individual: US$21.95 (original price US$19.95)

Other Apple One plans remain unchanged. When Apple raised the Apple Music monthly fee last month, it also raised the Apple One Family and Apple One Premier plans' monthly fees at the same time, but did not adjust the Individual plan price at that time.

The new rates apply immediately to new subscribers. Apple said existing subscribers will be notified of the price adjustment about one month before the new rates take effect.

Apple's last adjustment to the Apple TV+ monthly fee was in August last year, when the monthly fee was raised from US$9.99 to US$12.99; that price increase did not adjust the annual plan or Apple One bundle prices.

Apple has significantly expanded the Apple TV+ content lineup over the past year. In October last year, Apple announced it became the exclusive broadcast partner for Formula 1 in the United States; F1 race live broadcasts are now included in standard Apple TV+ subscriptions at no extra charge.

Earlier this year, Apple also added Major League Soccer (MLS) live broadcasts to the Apple TV+ platform, again at no extra charge. Previously, watching MLS matches required a separate MLS Season Pass subscription.

Apple has also benefited from the recent successful launch of several programmes, such as the fourth season of Ted Lasso. Apple TV+ also premieres the second season of Dark Matter today, with the sixth season of Slow Horses set to premiere on 16 September.

What do you think of the new Apple TV+ monthly fee? At US$14.99 per month, is Apple TV+ content worth the price? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
